occupation: regular position in Indian Institute of repute
Indian organization/institution (e.g., science and technology parks, incubation centers)
other_conditions: Only private and public limited companies registered under the Companies Act may apply for the Main, MSME and Startup categories
Startup applications must have DPIIT registration
Women‑led enterprises are eligible as per Government of India norms

Applicants for the Translational Research category must hold a regular position in a reputable Indian Institute and have patents/technology transfer/licensing to Indian industry with commercial revenue and socio‑economic impact

Technology Business Incubator award is limited to Indian organizations/institutions that have been operating for more than 5 years (registered on or before March 2017) and are not‑for‑profit entities; individual applicants are not considered
benefits_summary: Cash prizes ranging from ₹5 lakh to ₹25 lakh (plus trophies for Main and Translational Research awards) are awarded to the selected winners.
documents_required: Aadhaar or other valid identity proof
Aadhaar number of authorized person (for organization applicants)
